verses.1:1: Since many have undertaken to draw up a narrative concerning the events that have been fulfilled among us,
verses.1:2: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and attendants of the word handed them down to us,
verses.1:3: it seemed good to me also, having traced everything accurately from the beginning, to write to you in sequence, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.1:4: so that you may know the certainty regarding the accounts about which you were instructed.
verses.1:5: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a certain priest named Zechariah, from the division of Abijah; and he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.1:6: Now both of them were righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
verses.1:7: And they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and both of them were advanced in their days.
verses.1:8: Now it happened, while he was serving as priest in the order of his division before God,
verses.1:9: according to the custom of the priesthood, it fell to him by lot to burn incense upon entering the sanctuary of the Lord,
verses.1:10: and the entire multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.1:11: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.1:12: And Zechariah was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
verses.1:13: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your petition has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear a son for you, and you will call his name John.
verses.1:14: And there will be joy and gladness for you, and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.1:15: For he will be great before the Lord, and he will by no means drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb,
verses.1:16: and he will turn many of the sons of Israel back to the Lord their God.
verses.1:17: And he himself will go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of fathers to children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, to prepare for the Lord a people made ready."
verses.1:18: And Zechariah said to the angel, "How will I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in her days."
verses.1:19: And the angel answered and said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands before God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
verses.1:20: And look, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day these things happen, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time."
verses.1:21: And the people were waiting for Zechariah, and they were marveling at his lingering in the sanctuary.
verses.1:22: But when he came out, he was unable to speak to them, and they realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary; and he kept making signs to them, and remained mute.
verses.1:23: And it happened, when the days of his service were completed, that he departed to his house.
verses.1:24: Now after these days his wife Elizabeth conceived, and she kept herself hidden for five months, saying,
verses.1:25: "In this way the Lord has acted for me in the days when He looked with favor to take away my disgrace among people."
verses.1:26: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
verses.1:27: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
verses.1:28: And having come in to her, the angel said, "Greetings, you who have been shown favor; the Lord is with you."
verses.1:29: But she was greatly troubled at this statement and kept pondering what kind of greeting this might be.
verses.1:30: And the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
verses.1:31: And look, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and you will call His name Jesus.
verses.1:32: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give to Him the throne of His father David,
verses.1:33: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and there will be no end to His kingdom."
verses.1:34: Then Mary said to the angel, "How will this be, since I do not know a man?"
verses.1:35: And the angel answered and said to her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore also the one to be born will be called holy, the Son of God.
verses.1:36: And look, your relative Elizabeth has herself also conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month for her who was called barren.
verses.1:37: For no word from God will be impossible."
verses.1:38: And Mary said, "Here is the servant of the Lord; may it happen to me according to your word." And the angel departed from her.
verses.1:39: Now in these days Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country, to a city of Judah,
verses.1:40: and she entered the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
verses.1:41: And it happened, when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, that the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,
verses.1:42: and she cried out with a loud voice and said, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
verses.1:43: And why has this happened to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.1:44: For look, when the sound of your greeting came into my ears, the baby in my womb leaped with gladness.
verses.1:45: And blessed is she who believed that there will be a fulfillment of the things spoken to her from the Lord."
verses.1:46: And Mary said, "My soul extols the Lord,
verses.1:47: and my spirit has exulted in God my Savior,
verses.1:48: because He has looked upon the humble condition of His servant; for look, from now on all generations will call me blessed.
verses.1:49: For the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is His name,
verses.1:50: and His mercy is to generations and generations for those who fear Him.
verses.1:51: He has exercised might with His arm; He has scattered the proud in the thoughts of their heart.
verses.1:52: He has brought down rulers from thrones and lifted up the humble;
verses.1:53: He has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich He has sent away empty.
verses.1:54: He has come to the aid of His servant Israel, in remembrance of mercy,
verses.1:55: just as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his offspring forever."
verses.1:56: And Mary stayed with her about three months and returned to her house.
verses.1:57: Now the time was fulfilled for Elizabeth to give birth, and she bore a son.
verses.1:58: And her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had magnified His mercy toward her, and they were rejoicing with her.
verses.1:59: And it happened on the eighth day that they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to call him Zechariah, after the name of his father.
verses.1:60: And his mother answered and said, "No; rather, he will be called John."
verses.1:61: And they said to her, "There is no one from your relatives who is called by this name."
verses.1:62: Then they were making signs to his father as to what he would want him to be called.
verses.1:63: And asking for a writing tablet, he wrote, saying, "John is his name." And they all marveled.
verses.1:64: And immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue freed, and he began speaking, blessing God.
verses.1:65: And fear came upon all those living around them, and throughout the entire hill country of Judea all these matters were being talked about,
verses.1:66: and all who heard stored them in their hearts, saying, "What then will this child be?" For indeed the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.1:67: And his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied, saying,
verses.1:68: "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and accomplished redemption for His people,
verses.1:69: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
verses.1:70: just as He spoke through the mouth of His holy prophets from ancient times:
verses.1:71: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
verses.1:72: to show mercy toward our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
verses.1:73: the oath that He swore to our father Abraham, to grant to us,
verses.1:74: having been rescued from the hand of enemies, to serve Him without fear
verses.1:75: in holiness and righteousness before Him all our days.
verses.1:76: And you also, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the Lord to prepare His ways,
verses.1:77: to give knowledge of salvation to His people in the forgiveness of their sins,
verses.1:78: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
verses.1:79: to shine upon those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace."
verses.1:80: Now the child kept growing and becoming strong in spirit, and he was in the deserts until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
verses.2:1: Now it happened in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus for all the inhabited world to be registered.
verses.2:2: (This first registration took place while Quirinius was governing Syria.)
verses.2:3: And all were going to be registered, each one to his own city.
verses.2:4: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David,
verses.2:5: to be registered along with Mary, who was betrothed to him and was pregnant.
verses.2:6: Now it happened while they were there that the days were completed for her to give birth.
verses.2:7: And she gave birth to her firstborn son; and she wrapped Him in strips of cloth and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the lodging place.
verses.2:8: And there were shepherds in that same region staying out in the fields and keeping night watches over their flock.
verses.2:9: And an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they feared with great fear.
verses.2:10: And the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for see, I announce to you good news of great joy that will be for all the people,
verses.2:11: because today a Savior has been born for you, who is Christ the Lord, in the city of David.
verses.2:12: And this will be the sign for you: you will find an infant wrapped in strips of cloth and lying in a manger."
verses.2:13: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army, praising God and saying,
verses.2:14: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among people of His good pleasure."
verses.2:15: And it happened, as the angels departed from them into heaven, that the shepherds were saying to one another, "Let us indeed go across to Bethlehem and see this matter that has taken place, which the Lord made known to us."
verses.2:16: And hurrying, they came and found both Mary and Joseph, and the infant lying in the manger.
verses.2:17: And when they saw this, they made known the message that had been spoken to them concerning this child.
verses.2:18: And all who heard marveled at the things that were spoken to them by the shepherds,
verses.2:19: but Mary was carefully preserving all these matters, weighing them together in her heart.
verses.2:20: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God over everything they had heard and seen, just as it was spoken to them.
verses.2:21: And when eight days were completed to circumcise Him, His name was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.
verses.2:22: And when the days of their purification were completed according to the Law of Moses, they brought Him up to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord,
verses.2:23: just as it is written in the Law of the Lord, "Every male opening the womb will be called holy to the Lord,"
verses.2:24: and to offer a sacrifice according to what is stated in the Law of the Lord, a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.
verses.2:25: Now look, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon, and this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
verses.2:26: And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.2:27: And he came in the Spirit into the temple; and as the parents brought in the child Jesus to do according to the custom of the Law concerning Him,
verses.2:28: then he himself received Him into his arms and blessed God and said,
verses.2:29: "Now You are releasing Your servant, Master, according to Your word, in peace;
verses.2:30: for my eyes have seen Your salvation,
verses.2:31: which You have prepared before the face of all the peoples,
verses.2:32: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of Your people Israel."
verses.2:33: And His father and mother were marveling at the things being spoken about Him.
verses.2:34: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary His mother, "Look, this one is appointed for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign that is spoken against,
verses.2:35: and a sword will pierce through your own soul also, so that thoughts from many hearts may be revealed."
verses.2:36: And there was Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was advanced in many days, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
verses.2:37: and she was a widow up to eighty-four years of age), who did not depart from the temple, serving with fastings and petitions night and day.
verses.2:38: And coming up at that very hour, she began giving thanks to God and was speaking about Him to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.
verses.2:39: And when they had finished everything according to the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city of Nazareth.
verses.2:40: And the child was growing and becoming strong, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.
verses.2:41: Now His parents went year by year to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
verses.2:42: And when He was twelve years old, as they went up according to the custom of the feast
verses.2:43: and completed the days, while they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, and His parents did not know it.
verses.2:44: But supposing Him to be in the traveling company, they went a day's journey and were searching for Him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.2:45: And not finding Him, they returned to Jerusalem, searching for Him.
verses.2:46: And it happened after three days that they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.2:47: And all who were listening to Him were amazed at His understanding and His answers.
verses.2:48: And when they saw Him, they were astonished; and His mother said to Him, "Child, why have You done this to us? Look, Your father and I have been looking for You in distress."
verses.2:49: And He said to them, "Why is it that you were looking for Me? Did you not know that I must be in My Father's house?"
verses.2:50: And they did not understand the saying that He spoke to them.
verses.2:51: And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and He remained subject to them. And His mother kept all the matters closely in her heart.
verses.2:52: And Jesus was advancing in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and people.
verses.3:1: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governing Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip was tetrarch of the region of Iturea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.3:2: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zechariah, in the wilderness.
verses.3:3: And he went into all the surrounding region of the Jordan, proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
verses.3:4: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling out in the wilderness: 'Prepare the way of the Lord; make His paths straight.'
verses.3:5: Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; and the crooked places will become straight, and the rough ways smooth roads;
verses.3:6: and all flesh will see the salvation of God."
verses.3:7: So he was saying to the crowds going out to be baptized by him, "Offspring of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
verses.3:8: Produce, therefore, fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say within yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father'; for I tell you that God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
verses.3:9: And even now the ax lies at the root of the trees; every tree, therefore, that does not produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.3:10: And the crowds were questioning him, saying, "What, then, should we do?"
verses.3:11: And answering, he was saying to them, "Let the one who has two tunics share with the one who has none, and let the one who has food do likewise."
verses.3:12: And tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, "Teacher, what should we do?"
verses.3:13: And he said to them, "Collect nothing more than what has been prescribed for you."
verses.3:14: And soldiers also were questioning him, saying, "What should we also do?" And he said to them, "Do not extort from anyone or accuse anyone falsely, and be content with your wages."
verses.3:15: Now while the people were in expectation, and all were reasoning in their hearts concerning John, whether he himself might be the Christ,
verses.3:16: John answered, saying to all, "I baptize you with water; but the One who is stronger than I is coming, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.3:17: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor thoroughly and to gather the wheat into His granary, but the chaff He will burn up with unquenchable fire."
verses.3:18: So with many other exhortations as well, he was preaching the good news to the people.
verses.3:19: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him concerning Herodias, his brother's wife, and concerning all the evil things that Herod had done,
verses.3:20: added this also to all of them: he locked John up in prison.
verses.3:21: Now it happened that when all the people were baptized, and after Jesus had been baptized and was praying, heaven was opened,
verses.3:22: and the Holy Spirit descended upon Him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came out of heaven: "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."
verses.3:23: Now Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began, being the son, as was supposed, of Joseph, the son of Heli,
verses.3:24: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
verses.3:25: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
verses.3:26: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
verses.3:27: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
verses.3:28: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
verses.3:29: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
verses.3:30: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
verses.3:31: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
verses.3:32: the son of Jesse, the son of Jobel, the son of Boaz, the son of Sala, the son of Nahshon,
verses.3:33: the son of Amminadab, the son of Admin, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
verses.3:34: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
verses.3:35: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
verses.3:36: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
verses.3:37: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan,
verses.3:38: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
verses.4:1: Now Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was being led by the Spirit in the wilderness
verses.4:2: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. And He ate nothing in those days, and when they were completed, He became hungry.
verses.4:3: Then the devil said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, speak to this stone that it may become bread."
verses.4:4: And Jesus replied to him, "It is written, 'Man will not live on bread alone.'"
verses.4:5: And leading Him up, he showed Him all the kingdoms of the inhabited world in an instant of time.
verses.4:6: And the devil said to Him, "To You I will give all this authority and their glory, because it has been handed over to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.
verses.4:7: Therefore, if You worship before me, it will all be Yours."
verses.4:8: And answering, Jesus said to him, "It is written, 'You will worship the Lord your God, and Him alone you will serve.'"
verses.4:9: Then he led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here;
verses.4:10: for it is written, 'He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully,'
verses.4:11: and, 'On their hands they will lift You up, so that You never strike Your foot against a stone.'"
verses.4:12: And answering, Jesus said to him, "It has been said, 'You will not put the Lord your God to the test.'"
verses.4:13: And when the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from Him until an appointed time.
verses.4:14: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee. And a report went out through all the surrounding region concerning Him.
verses.4:15: And He Himself was teaching in their synagogues, being praised by everyone.
verses.4:16: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been raised, and according to His custom He went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
verses.4:17: And a scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him, and unrolling the scroll, He found the place where it was written,
verses.4:18: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He anointed Me to announce good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to send out the oppressed in liberty,
verses.4:19: to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord."
verses.4:20: And rolling up the scroll and returning it to the attendant, He sat down; and the eyes of everyone in the synagogue were gazing intently at Him.
verses.4:21: Then He began to say to them, "Today this Scripture has been fulfilled in your ears."
verses.4:22: And all were bearing witness to Him and marveling at the words of grace that were coming out of His mouth, and they were saying, "Is this not the son of Joseph?"
verses.4:23: And He said to them, "Surely you will say this proverb to Me: 'Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we heard took place in Capernaum, do here also in Your hometown.'"
verses.4:24: And He said, "Truly I say to you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
verses.4:25: But in truth I say to you, there were many widows in the days of Elijah in Israel, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land,
verses.4:26: and to none of them was Elijah sent except to Zarephath in the region of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
verses.4:27: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian."
verses.4:28: And all in the synagogue were filled with fury as they heard these things,
verses.4:29: and rising up, they drove Him out of the city and led Him up to the brow of the hill on which their city had been built, so as to hurl Him down the cliff.
verses.4:30: But He Himself, passing through the midst of them, went on His way.
verses.4:31: And He went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. And He was teaching them on the Sabbaths;
verses.4:32: and they were astonished at His teaching, because His word was with authority.
verses.4:33: And in the synagogue there was a man having a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.4:34: "Ah! What is there between us and You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are: the Holy One of God."
verses.4:35: And Jesus rebuked it, saying, "Be silenced and come out of him!" And the demon threw him down in the middle and came out of him without harming him at all.
verses.4:36: And amazement came upon all, and they were talking with one another, saying, "What is this word, that with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out?"
verses.4:37: And news concerning Him was going out into every place in the surrounding region.
verses.4:38: Now rising up from the synagogue, He entered the house of Simon. And Simon's mother-in-law was gripped by a high fever, and they asked Him concerning her.
verses.4:39: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever, and it left her; and immediately rising up, she began to serve them.
verses.4:40: Now while the sun was setting, all those who had any who were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and laying His hands on each one of them, He was healing them.
verses.4:41: And demons also were coming out of many, crying out and saying, "You are the Son of God!" And rebuking them, He would not allow them to speak, because they knew Him to be the Christ.
verses.4:42: Now when day came, He went out and departed to a desolate place; and the crowds were searching for Him, and they came up to Him and tried to keep Him from going away from them.
verses.4:43: But He said to them, "I must announce the good news of the kingdom of God to the other cities also, because for this purpose I was sent."
verses.4:44: And He was proclaiming in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.5:1: Now it happened, as the crowd was pressing upon Him and hearing the word of God, that He was standing beside the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.5:2: and He saw two boats lying beside the lake, but the fishermen had stepped out of them and were washing the nets.
verses.5:3: Stepping into one of the boats, which belonged to Simon, He asked him to put out a little from the land. And sitting down, He was teaching the crowds from the boat.
verses.5:4: When He ceased speaking, He said to Simon, "Put out into the deep water and let down your nets for a catch."
verses.5:5: And Simon answered and said, "Master, we labored through the entire night and took nothing; yet at Your word I will let down the nets."
verses.5:6: And when they had done this, they enclosed a great multitude of fish, and their nets were beginning to tear.
verses.5:7: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both boats, so that they were sinking.
verses.5:8: But when Simon Peter saw this, he fell down at the knees of Jesus, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord."
verses.5:9: For astonishment had gripped him and all those who were with him at the catch of the fish which they had taken,
verses.5:10: and likewise also James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were associates of Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid; from now on you will be catching people alive."
verses.5:11: And having brought the boats to land, they left everything and followed Him.
verses.5:12: And it happened while He was in one of the cities, look, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and implored Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You are able to cleanse me."
verses.5:13: And stretching out His hand, He touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.5:14: And He ordered him to tell no one, "but go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing just as Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.5:15: Yet the report about Him was spreading even more, and large crowds were gathering together to hear and to be healed of their illnesses.
verses.5:16: But He Himself would withdraw to the desolate places and pray.
verses.5:17: And it happened on one of the days that He was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there, who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal.
verses.5:18: And look, men were carrying on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they were seeking to bring him in and lay him before Him.
verses.5:19: And not finding a way to bring him in because of the crowd, they went up onto the roof and lowered him with the cot through the tiles into the middle, in front of Jesus.
verses.5:20: And seeing their faith, He said, "Man, your sins have been forgiven you."
verses.5:21: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who is able to forgive sins except God alone?"
verses.5:22: But Jesus, knowing their reasonings, answered and said to them, "Why are you reasoning in your hearts?
verses.5:23: Which is easier, to say, 'Your sins have been forgiven you,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
verses.5:24: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins"—He said to the paralyzed man—"I say to you, get up, pick up your cot, and go to your house."
verses.5:25: And at once rising up before them, he picked up what he had been lying on and went away to his house, glorifying God.
verses.5:26: And amazement seized everyone, and they were glorifying God; and they were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen extraordinary things today."
verses.5:27: And after these things He went out and noticed a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax booth, and He said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.5:28: And leaving everything behind, he got up and began following Him.
verses.5:29: And Levi gave a great banquet for Him in his house, and there was a large crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining at table with them.
verses.5:30: And the Pharisees and their scribes were grumbling at His disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.5:31: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Those who are healthy have no need of a physician, but those who are ill;
verses.5:32: I have not come to call righteous people, but sinners, to repentance."
verses.5:33: And they said to Him, "The disciples of John fast frequently and offer prayers, and likewise those of the Pharisees, but Yours eat and drink."
verses.5:34: And Jesus said to them, "You cannot make the sons of the bridal chamber fast while the bridegroom is with them, can you?
verses.5:35: Yet days will come, and when the bridegroom is taken away from them, then they will fast in those days."
verses.5:36: And He was also telling a parable to them: "No one tears a patch from a new garment and puts it on an old garment; otherwise, he will both tear the new one, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
verses.5:37: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise, the new wine will burst the wineskins, and it will be spilled out, and the wineskins will be ruined.
verses.5:38: Rather, new wine must be put into fresh wineskins.
verses.5:39: And no one, after drinking old wine, desires new; for he says, 'The old is good.'"
verses.6:1: Now it happened on a Sabbath that He was passing through grainfields, and His disciples were plucking and eating the heads of grain, rubbing them with their hands.
verses.6:2: But some of the Pharisees said, "Why are you doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.6:3: And answering them, Jesus said, "Have you not even read this, what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
verses.6:4: how he entered the house of God, and took and ate the loaves of presentation and gave to those with him, which it is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?"
verses.6:5: And He was saying to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
verses.6:6: Now it happened on another Sabbath that He entered the synagogue and was teaching; and a man was there, and his right hand was withered.
verses.6:7: And the scribes and the Pharisees were watching Him closely to see whether He would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find grounds to accuse Him.
verses.6:8: But He knew their reasonings, and He said to the man who had the withered hand, "Rise and stand in the middle." And rising up, he stood.
verses.6:9: Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you whether it is lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save a life or to destroy it?"
verses.6:10: And after looking around at them all, He said to him, "Stretch out your hand." And he did so, and his hand was restored.
verses.6:11: But they were filled with senseless rage, and were discussing with one another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.6:12: Now it happened in these days that He went out to the mountain to pray, and He was spending the whole night in prayer to God.
verses.6:13: And when day came, He called His disciples to Himself, and chose twelve from among them, whom He also named apostles:
verses.6:14: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother, and James and John, and Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.6:15: and Matthew and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon who was called the Zealot,
verses.6:16: and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
verses.6:17: And having come down with them, He stood on a level place, and there was a large crowd of His disciples and a great multitude of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon,
verses.6:18: who came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases; and those who were troubled by unclean spirits were being cured.
verses.6:19: And the whole crowd was seeking to touch Him, because power was going out from Him and healing them all.
verses.6:20: And lifting up His eyes toward His disciples, He was saying, "Blessed are the poor, because yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.6:21: Blessed are you who hunger now, because you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, because you will laugh.
verses.6:22: Blessed are you whenever people hate you, and whenever they exclude you and insult you and cast out your name as evil on account of the Son of Man.
verses.6:23: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for look, your reward is great in heaven; for their fathers used to do the same things to the prophets.
verses.6:24: Yet woe to you who are rich, because you have received your consolation in full.
verses.6:25: Woe to you who are full now, because you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, because you will mourn and weep.
verses.6:26: Woe whenever all people speak well of you, for their fathers used to do the same things to the false prophets.
verses.6:27: But to you who hear I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.6:28: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
verses.6:29: To the one who strikes you on the cheek, offer the other also; and from the one who takes away your cloak, do not withhold your tunic either.
verses.6:30: Give to everyone who asks you, and from the one who takes away what is yours, do not demand it back.
verses.6:31: And just as you want people to do to you, do likewise to them.
verses.6:32: And if you love those who love you, what credit is there for you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.6:33: For if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is there for you? Even sinners do the same.
verses.6:34: And if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is there for you? Even sinners lend to sinners so that they may receive back an equal amount.
verses.6:35: Yet love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, because He Himself is kind toward the ungrateful and evil.
verses.6:36: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
verses.6:37: And do not judge, and you will certainly not be judged; and do not condemn, and you will certainly not be condemned. Release, and you will be released;
verses.6:38: give, and it will be given to you: a good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, they will put into your lap. For with the measure by which you measure, it will be measured back to you."
verses.6:39: And He also spoke a parable to them: "Can a blind man guide a blind man? Will not both fall into a pit?
verses.6:40: A disciple is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
verses.6:41: And why do you look at the speck that is in your brother's eye, yet do not notice the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.6:42: How can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me take out the speck that is in your eye,' when you yourself do not see the beam that is in your own eye? Hypocrite, first take out the beam from your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the speck that is in your brother's eye.
verses.6:43: For there is no good tree producing bad fruit, nor again a bad tree producing good fruit.
verses.6:44: For each tree is known by its own fruit; for people do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they pick grapes from a bramble bush.
verses.6:45: The good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth what is good, and the evil man out of evil brings forth what is evil; for out of the overflow of the heart his mouth speaks.
verses.6:46: And why do you call Me, 'Lord, Lord,' and not do what I say?
verses.6:47: Everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and does them, I will show you whom he is like:
verses.6:48: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation upon the rock; and when a flood arose, the river burst against that house, and was not able to shake it, because it had been built well.
verses.6:49: But the one who heard and did not act is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation, against which the river burst, and immediately it collapsed, and the ruin of that house was great."
verses.7:1: When He had completed all His words in the hearing of the people, He entered Capernaum.
verses.7:2: Now a certain centurion's slave, who was highly valued by him, was ill and about to die.
verses.7:3: When he heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to Him, asking Him to come and heal his slave.
verses.7:4: When they arrived before Jesus, they earnestly pleaded with Him, saying, "He is worthy for You to grant him this,
verses.7:5: for he loves our nation, and he himself built the synagogue for us."
verses.7:6: So Jesus was going with them. And when He was already not far from the house, the centurion sent friends, saying to Him, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy for You to come under my roof;
verses.7:7: for this reason I did not even consider myself worthy to come to You. Instead, speak a word, and let my servant be healed.
verses.7:8: For I too am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under myself, and I say to this one, 'Go,' and he goes, and to another, 'Come,' and he comes, and to my slave, 'Do this,' and he does it."
verses.7:9: When Jesus heard these things, He marveled at him, and turning to the crowd following Him, He said, "I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith."
verses.7:10: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave in good health.
verses.7:11: And it happened soon afterward that He went to a city called Nain, and His disciples and a large crowd were going along with Him.
verses.7:12: Now as He approached the gate of the city, look, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and a sizable crowd from the city was with her.
verses.7:13: When the Lord saw her, He was moved with compassion for her and said to her, "Do not weep."
verses.7:14: And coming forward, He touched the bier, and those carrying it stood still. And He said, "Young man, I say to you, arise."
verses.7:15: And the dead man sat up and began to speak, and He gave him to his mother.
verses.7:16: Fear seized everyone, and they were glorifying God, saying, "A great prophet has been raised up among us," and, "God has visited His people."
verses.7:17: And this report concerning Him went out throughout all Judea and all the surrounding region.
verses.7:18: John's disciples reported to him about all these things. And calling two of his disciples to himself, John
verses.7:19: sent them to Jesus, saying, "Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for another?"
verses.7:20: When the men came to Him, they said, "John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, 'Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for another?'"
verses.7:21: In that hour He healed many of diseases, afflictions, and evil spirits, and to many who were blind He graciously granted sight.
verses.7:22: And answering, He said to them, "Go and report to John what you have seen and heard: the blind receive sight, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised, the poor have the good news proclaimed to them.
verses.7:23: And blessed is whoever does not stumble because of Me."
verses.7:24: When John's messengers had departed, He began to speak to the crowds concerning John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to observe? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.7:25: But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft garments? Look, those who are in splendid clothing and luxury are in royal palaces.
verses.7:26: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
verses.7:27: This is the one about whom it is written, 'Look, I am sending My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way ahead of You.'
verses.7:28: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
verses.7:29: (When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they vindicated God, having been baptized with the baptism of John;
verses.7:30: but the Pharisees and the experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves, not having been baptized by him.)
verses.7:31: "To what then shall I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?
verses.7:32: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another, who say, 'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.'
verses.7:33: For John the Baptist has come neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'
verses.7:34: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Look, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'
verses.7:35: Yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children."
verses.7:36: Now one of the Pharisees was asking Him to eat with him; and having entered the Pharisee's house, He reclined at table.
verses.7:37: And look, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she learned that He was reclining at table in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster jar of fragrant oil,
verses.7:38: and standing behind Him at His feet, weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears and was wiping them with the hair of her head, kissing His feet and anointing them with the fragrant oil.
verses.7:39: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he spoke to himself, saying, "If this man were a prophet, He would know who and what sort of woman this is who is touching Him, that she is a sinner."
verses.7:40: And answering, Jesus said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." And he said, "Teacher, say it."
verses.7:41: "A certain moneylender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.7:42: Since they had nothing with which to repay, he graciously forgave them both. Which of them, therefore, will love him more?"
verses.7:43: Simon answered and said, "I suppose the one whom he forgave the larger amount." And He said to him, "You have judged rightly."
verses.7:44: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, yet she has wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
verses.7:45: You gave Me no kiss; yet from the time I entered, she has not ceased kissing My feet.
verses.7:46: You did not anoint My head with oil; yet she has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.
verses.7:47: For this reason, I tell you, her sins, which are many, have been forgiven, for she has loved much; but the one to whom little is forgiven loves little."
verses.7:48: And He said to her, "Your sins have been forgiven."
verses.7:49: And those who were reclining at table with Him began to say among themselves, "Who is this man who even forgives sins?"
verses.7:50: And He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.8:1: And it happened afterward that He was journeying through each city and village, proclaiming and announcing the good news of the kingdom of God, and the twelve were with Him,
verses.8:2: along with certain women who had been healed from evil spirits and illnesses: Mary, who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
verses.8:3: and Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's manager, and Susanna, and many other women, who were ministering to them out of their own possessions.
verses.8:4: Now when a large crowd was gathering together and people from city after city were coming to Him, He spoke by way of a parable:
verses.8:5: "The sower went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some fell beside the road, and it was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
verses.8:6: And other seed fell down onto the rock, and when it sprouted, it dried up because it had no moisture.
verses.8:7: And other seed fell in the midst of the thorns, and the thorns grew up together with it and choked it.
verses.8:8: And other seed fell into the good soil, and when it sprouted, it produced fruit a hundredfold." As He said these things, He called out, "The one who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.8:9: Now His disciples were questioning Him as to what this parable might be.
verses.8:10: And He said, "To you it has been granted to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest it is in parables, so that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.
verses.8:11: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.8:12: And those beside the road are the ones who have heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they may not believe and be saved.
verses.8:13: And those on the rock are the ones who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root; they believe for a time, and in a time of testing they fall away.
verses.8:14: And that which fell into the thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and as they go along they are choked by anxieties and wealth and pleasures of life, and they do not bring fruit to maturity.
verses.8:15: And that in the good soil, these are the ones who, having heard the word with a noble and good heart, hold it fast and bear fruit with endurance.
verses.8:16: Now no one, having lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or places it underneath a bed, but places it on a lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.8:17: For nothing is hidden that will not become manifest, nor anything concealed that will not be made known and come into the open.
verses.8:18: Watch, therefore, how you hear; for whoever has, to him it will be given, and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him."
verses.8:19: Now His mother and His brothers came to Him, and they were unable to get to Him because of the crowd.
verses.8:20: And it was reported to Him, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wishing to see You."
verses.8:21: And He answered and said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it."
verses.8:22: Now it happened on one of those days that He stepped into a boat along with His disciples, and He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side of the lake." And they launched out.
verses.8:23: And while they were sailing, He fell asleep. And a squall of wind came down onto the lake, and they were filling with water and were in danger.
verses.8:24: And they came to Him and woke Him up, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" And having woken up, He rebuked the wind and the surging waves of the water, and they ceased, and there came a calm.
verses.8:25: And He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And struck with fear, they marveled, saying to one another, "Who then is this, that He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?"
verses.8:26: And they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is directly opposite Galilee.
verses.8:27: And as He stepped out onto the land, a certain man from the city who had demons met Him; and for a long time he had not worn clothing, and he was not staying in a house, but in the tombs.
verses.8:28: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out, fell down before Him, and said with a loud voice, "What is there between me and You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"
verses.8:29: For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For many times it had seized him, and though he was kept under guard, bound with chains and shackles, he would break the bonds apart and be driven by the demon into the deserted places.
verses.8:30: And Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" And he answered, "Legion," because many demons had entered into him.
verses.8:31: And they were imploring Him not to command them to go away into the abyss.
verses.8:32: Now there was a large herd of pigs feeding there on the mountain; and they implored Him to permit them to enter into them, and He permitted them.
verses.8:33: And the demons came out from the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
verses.8:34: And when the herdsmen saw what had happened, they fled and reported it in the city and in the countryside.
verses.8:35: And people went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind; and they became afraid.
verses.8:36: And those who had witnessed it reported to them how the man who had been demon-possessed had been made well.
verses.8:37: And the entire multitude of the surrounding region of the Gerasenes asked Him to depart from them, because they were gripped with great fear; so He got into a boat and returned.
verses.8:38: Now the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him that he might be with Him, but He sent him away, saying,
verses.8:39: "Return to your house, and recount all that God has done for you." And he went away, proclaiming throughout the entire city all that Jesus had done for him.
verses.8:40: Now as Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all waiting expectantly for Him.
verses.8:41: And look, a man came whose name was Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue; and falling at the feet of Jesus, he implored Him to come into his house,
verses.8:42: because he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. Now as He was going, the crowds were crushing in around Him.
verses.8:43: And a woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent her entire livelihood on physicians and could not be healed by anyone,
verses.8:44: approached from behind and touched the fringe of His garment, and immediately her flow of blood stopped.
verses.8:45: And Jesus said, "Who is the one who touched Me?" And as all were denying it, Peter said, "Master, the crowds are hemming You in and pressing against You."
verses.8:46: But Jesus said, "Someone touched Me, for I perceived that power has gone out from Me."
verses.8:47: And when the woman saw that she had not gone unnoticed, she came trembling and fell down before Him, and declared in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched Him and how she had been healed immediately.
verses.8:48: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace."
verses.8:49: While He was still speaking, someone came from the synagogue ruler's house, saying, "Your daughter has died; do not trouble the Teacher any longer."
verses.8:50: But Jesus, hearing this, answered him, "Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be made well."
verses.8:51: And when He came to the house, He did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter and John and James, and the father and the mother of the child.
verses.8:52: Now everyone was weeping and mourning for her, but He said, "Stop weeping, for she has not died, but is sleeping."
verses.8:53: And they were laughing at Him, knowing that she had died.
verses.8:54: But He took hold of her hand and called out, saying, "Child, rise."
verses.8:55: And her spirit returned, and she got up immediately; and He directed that something be given to her to eat.
verses.8:56: And her parents were amazed, but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.
verses.9:1: Now having called the twelve together, He gave them power and authority over all the demons and to heal diseases.
verses.9:2: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to cure the sick.
verses.9:3: And He said to them, "Take nothing for the journey, neither a staff, nor a bag, nor bread, nor money; nor are you to have two tunics.
verses.9:4: And whatever house you enter, remain there and depart from there.
verses.9:5: And as for all who do not receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off the dust from your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.9:6: So going out, they were traveling through the villages, announcing the good news and healing everywhere.
verses.9:7: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all the things that were happening, and he was thoroughly perplexed because it was being said by some that John had been raised from the dead,
verses.9:8: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the ancient prophets had risen.
verses.9:9: And Herod said, "I myself beheaded John, but who is this man about whom I hear such things?" And he kept seeking to see Him.
verses.9:10: When the apostles returned, they recounted to Him all that they had done. And taking them along, He withdrew privately to a city called Bethsaida.
verses.9:11: But when the crowds found out, they followed Him. And welcoming them, He was speaking to them about the kingdom of God and curing those who had need of healing.
verses.9:12: Now the day began to decline, and the twelve came up and said to Him, "Send the crowd away, so that going into the surrounding villages and countryside they may lodge and find provisions, because here we are in a desolate place."
verses.9:13: But He said to them, "You yourselves give them something to eat." And they said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless perhaps we ourselves go and buy food for all these people."
verses.9:14: For there were about five thousand men. And He said to His disciples, "Have them recline in groups of about fifty each."
verses.9:15: And they did so, and had them all recline.
verses.9:16: Then taking the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up toward heaven, He blessed them and broke them, and kept giving them to the disciples to set before the crowd.
verses.9:17: And they all ate and were satisfied, and what was left over by them was picked up, twelve baskets of broken pieces.
verses.9:18: And it happened that while He was praying alone, the disciples were with Him, and He questioned them, saying, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
verses.9:19: And answering, they said, "John the Baptist, and others say Elijah, and others that one of the ancient prophets has risen."
verses.9:20: And He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" And answering, Peter said, "The Christ of God."
verses.9:21: But strictly warning them, He instructed them to tell this to no one,
verses.9:22: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised on the third day."
verses.9:23: And He was saying to them all, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
verses.9:24: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life on account of Me, that one will save it.
verses.9:25: For what is a person profited if he gains the whole world, yet loses or forfeits himself?
verses.9:26: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of that one the Son of Man will be ashamed when He comes in His glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
verses.9:27: But I say to you truly, there are some of those standing here who will certainly not taste death until they see the kingdom of God."
verses.9:28: Now it happened about eight days after these words that, taking Peter and John and James along, He went up onto the mountain to pray.
verses.9:29: And it happened while He was praying that the appearance of His face became different, and His clothing became gleaming white.
verses.9:30: And look, two men were talking with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,
verses.9:31: who, having appeared in glory, were speaking of His departure, which He was about to fulfill in Jerusalem.
verses.9:32: Now Peter and those with him were weighed down with sleep; but becoming fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men standing with Him.
verses.9:33: And it happened as they were parting from Him that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tents, one for You, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah"—not knowing what he was saying.
verses.9:34: While he was saying these things, a cloud appeared and was overshadowing them; and they became afraid as they entered into the cloud.
verses.9:35: Then a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My Son, the Chosen One; listen to Him!"
verses.9:36: And when the voice had sounded, Jesus was found alone. And they kept silent, and in those days reported to no one anything of the things they had seen.
verses.9:37: Now it happened on the next day, when they came down from the mountain, that a large crowd met Him.
verses.9:38: And look, a man from the crowd shouted, saying, "Teacher, I beg You to look upon my son, because he is my only child,
verses.9:39: and look, a spirit seizes him, and suddenly he cries out, and it convulses him with foaming, and scarcely withdraws from him, mauling him;
verses.9:40: and I begged Your disciples to cast it out, and they were not able."
verses.9:41: And answering, Jesus said, "O unbelieving and twisted generation, how long will I be with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."
verses.9:42: Even while he was approaching, the demon threw him down and violently convulsed him. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and cured the boy and gave him back to his father.
verses.9:43: And all were astonished at the majesty of God. Now while everyone was marveling at all the things He was doing, He said to His disciples,
verses.9:44: "As for you, put these words into your ears, for the Son of Man is about to be handed over into the hands of men."
verses.9:45: But they did not understand this saying, and it was concealed from them so that they might not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this saying.
verses.9:46: Now an argument arose among them as to which of them might be the greatest.
verses.9:47: But Jesus, knowing the reasoning of their heart, took hold of a little child and set him beside Himself,
verses.9:48: and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me; for the one who is least among all of you, this one is great."
verses.9:49: And answering, John said, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him because he does not follow along with us."
verses.9:50: But Jesus said to him, "Do not stop him, for whoever is not against you is for you."
verses.9:51: Now it happened, as the days for His being taken up were being fulfilled, that He Himself set His face firmly to go to Jerusalem,
verses.9:52: and He sent messengers ahead of Him. And going on, they entered a village of the Samaritans to make preparations for Him;
verses.9:53: yet they did not receive Him, because His face was set on going to Jerusalem.
verses.9:54: And seeing this, the disciples James and John said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them?"
verses.9:56: And they went on to another village.
verses.9:57: And as they were going along the road, someone said to Him, "I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.9:58: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have dens and the birds of the sky have nests, yet the Son of Man has nowhere to rest His head."
verses.9:59: And He said to another, "Follow Me." But he said, "Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father."
verses.9:60: But He said to him, "Leave the dead to bury their own dead; as for you, go and proclaim the kingdom of God."
verses.9:61: And another also said, "I will follow You, Lord; but first permit me to say farewell to those in my house."
verses.9:62: But Jesus said, "No one who has put his hand to a plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
verses.10:1: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him into every city and place where He Himself was about to come.
verses.10:2: And He was saying to them, "The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the workers are few; therefore plead with the Lord of the harvest so that He may send out workers into His harvest.
verses.10:3: Go; look, I am sending you out as lambs in the midst of wolves.
verses.10:4: Carry no money bag, no travel bag, no sandals; and do not greet anyone along the road.
verses.10:5: Whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace to this house.'
verses.10:6: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest upon him; but if not, it will return to you.
verses.10:7: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking what they provide, for the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move from house to house.
verses.10:8: And whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat what is set before you,
verses.10:9: and heal those in it who are sick, and say to them, 'The kingdom of God has drawn near to you.'
verses.10:10: But whatever city you enter and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.10:11: 'Even the dust from your city that clung to our feet we wipe off against you; yet know this, that the kingdom of God has drawn near.'
verses.10:12: I say to you that it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that city.
verses.10:13: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty deeds that were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.10:14: Yet it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
verses.10:15: And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? You will descend to Hades.
verses.10:16: The one who listens to you listens to Me, and the one who rejects you rejects Me; and the one who rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me."
verses.10:17: Now the seventy-two returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name!"
verses.10:18: And He said to them, "I was watching Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
verses.10:19: Look, I have given you the authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing will by any means harm you.
verses.10:20: Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names have been written in the heavens."
verses.10:21: In that same hour He exulted in the Holy Spirit and said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You hid these things from the wise and understanding and revealed them to infants; yes, Father, because this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
verses.10:22: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son and anyone to whom the Son wills to reveal Him."
verses.10:23: And turning to the disciples privately, He said, "Blessed are the eyes that see the things you see.
verses.10:24: For I say to you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things you see and did not see them, and to hear the things you hear and did not hear them."
verses.10:25: And look, a certain expert in the law stood up, testing Him and saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.10:26: And He said to him, "What is written in the law? How do you read it?"
verses.10:27: And he answered and said, "You shall love the Lord your God from your whole heart, and with your whole soul, and with your whole strength, and with your whole mind, and your neighbor as yourself."
verses.10:28: And He said to him, "You have answered rightly; do this, and you will live."
verses.10:29: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.10:30: Jesus replied and said, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who stripped him and inflicted blows upon him, and went away leaving him half dead.
verses.10:31: Now by chance a certain priest was going down along that road, and seeing him, he passed by on the opposite side.
verses.10:32: And likewise a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the opposite side.
verses.10:33: But a certain Samaritan who was journeying came upon him, and when he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
verses.10:34: and approaching, he bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and placing him on his own animal, he brought him to an inn and took care of him.
verses.10:35: And on the next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper and said, 'Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I return.'
verses.10:36: Which of these three seems to you to have become a neighbor to the one who fell among the robbers?"
verses.10:37: And he said, "The one who showed mercy to him." And Jesus said to him, "Go, and you do likewise."
verses.10:38: Now as they were going along, He entered a certain village; and a certain woman named Martha welcomed Him.
verses.10:39: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at the feet of Jesus and was listening to His word.
verses.10:40: But Martha was distracted with much serving; and stepping up, she said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me alone to serve? Tell her therefore to help me."
verses.10:41: But the Lord answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
verses.10:42: yet few things are needed, or one; for Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."
verses.11:1: And it came about, while He was praying in a certain place, that when He stopped, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."
verses.11:2: And He said to them, "When you pray, say: 'Father, may Your name be sanctified; may Your kingdom come.
verses.11:3: Give us our daily bread day by day,
verses.11:4: and forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us; and do not bring us into temptation.'"
verses.11:5: And He said to them, "Which of you will have a friend, and will go to him at midnight and say to him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves,
verses.11:6: since a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'
verses.11:7: and that one, answering from inside, will say, 'Do not cause me trouble; the door has already been shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot get up and give to you'?
verses.11:8: I tell you, even though he will not get up and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his shamelessness he will rise and give him as much as he needs.
verses.11:9: And I also say to you: ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.11:10: For everyone who asks receives, and whoever seeks finds, and to whoever knocks it will be opened.
verses.11:11: Now what father among you, when his son asks for a fish, will hand him a snake instead of a fish?
verses.11:12: Or if he also asks for an egg, will he hand him a scorpion?
verses.11:13: If then you, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father from heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?"
verses.11:14: And He was casting out a mute demon; and it came about that when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke, and the crowds marveled.
verses.11:15: But some of them said, "By Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons, He casts out the demons."
verses.11:16: And others, testing Him, were seeking from Him a sign from heaven.
verses.11:17: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and house falls upon house.
verses.11:18: And if Satan also has been divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? Because you say that I cast out the demons by Beelzebul.
verses.11:19: And if I cast out the demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? For this reason they themselves will be your judges.
verses.11:20: But if by the finger of God I cast out the demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.11:21: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own courtyard, his possessions are in peace;
verses.11:22: but when one stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes away his full armor in which he had trusted, and distributes his plunder.
verses.11:23: The one who is not with Me is against Me, and the one who does not gather with Me scatters.
verses.11:24: When the unclean spirit goes out from the person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and not finding any it says, 'I will return to my house from which I came out.'
verses.11:25: And when it comes, it finds it swept and put in order.
verses.11:26: Then it goes and takes along seven other spirits more evil than itself, and entering in they dwell there; and the last state of that person becomes worse than the first."
verses.11:27: Now it happened, while He was saying these things, that a certain woman from the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that carried You and the breasts that You nursed!"
verses.11:28: But He said, "Rather, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it."
verses.11:29: Now as the crowds were crowding together, He began to say, "This generation is an evil generation; it seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
verses.11:30: For just as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.
verses.11:31: The queen of the South will be raised up at the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and look, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.11:32: The men of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and look, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.11:33: No one, after lighting a lamp, puts it in a hidden place or under a measuring basket, but on the lampstand, so that those who come in may see the light.
verses.11:34: The lamp of the body is your eye. When your eye is sound, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body is also dark.
verses.11:35: Be careful, therefore, that the light that is in you is not darkness.
verses.11:36: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, having no dark part, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp illuminates you with its gleam."
verses.11:37: Now when He had spoken, a Pharisee asked Him to dine with him; and He went in and reclined at the table.
verses.11:38: But when the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that He had not first washed before the meal.
verses.11:39: And the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but your inside is full of extortion and wickedness.
verses.11:40: Foolish ones, did not the One who made the outside also make the inside?
verses.11:41: Nevertheless, give as alms the things that are inside, and look, everything is clean for you.
verses.11:42: But woe to you Pharisees, because you tithe mint and rue and every garden herb, and pass by justice and the love of God; yet these things you ought to have done without neglecting those.
verses.11:43: Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the foremost seat in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
verses.11:44: Woe to you, because you are like unmarked tombs, and the people who walk over them do not know it."
verses.11:45: Then one of the experts in the law answered and said to Him, "Teacher, by saying these things You insult us also."
verses.11:46: And He said, "Woe to you experts in the law as well, because you load people with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with even one of your fingers.
verses.11:47: Woe to you, because you build the tombs of the prophets, yet your fathers killed them.
verses.11:48: So then you are witnesses and approve of the deeds of your fathers, because they indeed killed them, and you do the building.
verses.11:49: For this reason the wisdom of God also said, 'I will send prophets and apostles to them, and some of them they will kill and persecute,'
verses.11:50: so that the blood of all the prophets, shed from the foundation of the world, may be required from this generation,
verses.11:51: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the house. Yes, I tell you, it will be required from this generation.
verses.11:52: Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key of knowledge; you did not enter yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering."
verses.11:53: And when He went out from there, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press Him fiercely and to cross-examine Him about many things,
verses.11:54: lying in wait for Him to catch something from His mouth.
verses.12:1: Meanwhile, when tens of thousands of the crowd had gathered together so that they were trampling on one another, He began to say to His disciples first, "Be on your guard against the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.12:2: Yet nothing is covered up that will not be uncovered, and nothing is hidden that will not be known.
verses.12:3: Therefore, whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and what you have spoken into the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
verses.12:4: Now I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that have nothing further they can do.
verses.12:5: But I will show you whom to fear: fear the One who, after killing, has authority to throw into hell; yes, I say to you, fear Him.
verses.12:6: Are not five sparrows sold for two copper coins? Yet not one of them is forgotten before God.
verses.12:7: Indeed, even the hairs of your head have all been numbered. Do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
verses.12:8: And I say to you, everyone who confesses Me before people, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God;
verses.12:9: but the one who denies Me before people will be disowned before the angels of God.
verses.12:10: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.
verses.12:11: Now when they bring you before the synagogues and the rulers and the authorities, do not be anxious about how or what you should answer in defense, or what you should say,
verses.12:12: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you must say."
verses.12:13: Then someone from the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
verses.12:14: But He said to him, "Man, who appointed Me a judge or a divider over you?"
verses.12:15: And He said to them, "Watch out and guard yourselves against every kind of greed, for even when someone has an abundance, his life does not come from his possessions."
verses.12:16: And He spoke a parable to them, saying, "The land of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.
verses.12:17: And he reasoned within himself, saying, 'What shall I do, because I have nowhere to gather my crops?'
verses.12:18: Then he said, 'This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and there I will gather all the grain and my goods,
verses.12:19: and I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have many goods stored up for many years; rest, eat, drink, enjoy yourself."'
verses.12:20: But God said to him, 'Fool! This very night your soul is demanded from you; and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?'
verses.12:21: So it is with the one who stores up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."
verses.12:22: And He said to His disciples, "For this reason I say to you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat, nor about your body, what you will put on.
verses.12:23: For the life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
verses.12:24: Consider the ravens: they neither sow nor reap, they have neither storeroom nor barn, yet God feeds them. How much more are you worth than the birds!
verses.12:25: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his lifespan?
verses.12:26: If then you cannot do even the smallest thing, why are you anxious about the rest?
verses.12:27: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither labor nor spin; yet I say to you, not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these.
verses.12:28: Now if God so clothes the grass in the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into an oven, how much more will He clothe you, you of little faith!
verses.12:29: And as for you, do not seek what you will eat and what you will drink, and do not live in anxious suspense,
verses.12:30: for all the nations of the world eagerly seek these things, and your Father knows that you need these things.
verses.12:31: Instead, seek His kingdom, and these things will be added to you.
verses.12:32: Do not be afraid, little flock, for it has pleased your Father to give you the kingdom.
